speaker: Doctor
text:
Can you tell me how long this back pain has been lasting and what makes it worse?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Lumbar Spine
REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Lumbar Spine findings indicate evidence of L5-S1 disc herniation impinging on the adjacent nerve root.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That MRI confirms a herniated disc at L5-S1. To assess the severity of the nerve compression, do you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your foot or toes?

Please also tell me if you have experienced any changes in bowel or bladder control.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: L5-S1 Disc Herniation. The combination of sudden onset after exercise, radiating pain down the leg, and MRI confirmation of an L5-S1 herniation impinging the nerve root is diagnostic.
